test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man covers a certain distance between his house and his office on a scooter. At an average speed of 30 km/h, he is late by 10 min. However, at a speed of 40 km/h he reaches his office 5 min earlier. Find the distance between his house and his office.
solution:
**Given:**

When he travelled at an average speed of 30 km/h, he is late by 10 minutes 

and at 40 km/h he is 5 minutes earlier.

**Calculations:**

Let, the distance between his house and office is X km.

When he covers 30 km/h

He covers X km in X/30 hours

Similarly, 

When he covers 40 km/h

He covers X km in X/40 hours

(X/30) - (X/40) = 15/60 hrs

X = 30 km

**Hence, The Required value is 30 Km.**
